scope: actual hookless MacBridge capture/direct AX mutation, not Controller, global hooks, physical typing, browser, terminal or screen-reader acceptance

transaction_frame_reads.fresh_barriers: independent ordinary captures; reuse ends before appearance/focus/anchor
transaction_frame_reads.scope: owned AX child only; no latency or external-host authority claim

safety.child_environment: cleared; fixed PATH/LANG/authorization plus canonical private INKLOW_HOME/HOME/CFFIXED_USER_HOME/TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP/XDG_CACHE_HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME
safety.filesystem_policy: canonical root/current-UID-owned chains; no extended ACL; group/world writable ancestors require sticky bit; root and same UID trusted
safety.remaining_os_side_effect_limit: AppKit/Foundation, LaunchServices, cfprefsd and text-service daemons may write account-wide preferences, caches, registration or service state outside these directories; HOME is not a sandbox. No host-wide no-write claim. Use a genuinely disposable macOS login account when normal-account side effects are unacceptable.
safety.window_restoration: process-local volatile defaults and non-restorable windows

source_identity.capture_phase: post-run source capture; not frozen prelaunch identity or proof of executed binary correspondence

not_established: browser or terminal or arbitrary external hosts
